changeSet.comment: Which dialect the provider is asked for a picture in. Nullable = the default (CHAT_MODALITIES, the OpenRouter convention we started from), so existing rows keep working untouched. It cannot be derived from provider_type: OpenRouter and Polza are both OPENAI_COMPATIBLE, yet Polza answers chat/completions for an image model either with a bare 500 (models whose output is image-only) or with 200, no picture and a full charge (models declaring image+text) — measured, see docs/decisions/media-transport.md. Nor can it be derived from the model: the same model id is reached over different dialects depending on who serves it.
